details: Decoder::new(Cursor) then read_info and next_frame into a freshly allocated buffer sized by output_buffer_size; default settings, no transformations. By default the crate checks each chunk's CRC but not the zlib stream's Adler-32. The file's bytes are made from hex once per fixture, outside the timed call. The decoder does not expand colour types, so the fixtures are all 8-bit RGBA.
